title: Elevated webhook delivery latency in EU-WEST
message: We are observing elevated p95 latency on outbound webhook delivery via the eu-west fanout. Investigation is in progress; ingestion and the public API are unaffected.

latest_update.message: Failover to the standby fanout completed. p95 has returned to baseline; we are monitoring before declaring resolved.

title: Search index reindex failure — partial results possible
message: A scheduled reindex of the search corpus failed to complete. Recently-created incidents may not appear in search until the reindex resumes.

latest_update.message: Identified a malformed mapping introduced in the 14:32 UTC deploy. Rolling forward with a corrected mapping; ETA 30 minutes.

title: Auth refresh tokens rejected in us-east-2
message: Long-lived OAuth refresh tokens were rejected for ~17 minutes after the auth pod rollout. New sessions and SSO flows were unaffected.

latest_update.message: Refresh tokens are validating again on all auth pods. Postmortem to follow within 5 business days.

title: Public API 502s during deploy window
message: The public API returned 502s for a small percentage of requests during the rolling deploy of api-platform v4.7.1.

latest_update.message: All pods are healthy; readiness gate has been tightened to prevent recurrence on future deploys.

title: Telemetry ingest backpressure on cardinality spike
message: OpenTelemetry ingest applied backpressure for ~9 minutes after a customer pushed a metric set with extreme tag cardinality.

latest_update.message: Cardinality limit enforced upstream; ingest p95 is back below 200ms.

title: Email delivery delays — Mailgun upstream incident
message: Email notifications were delayed by up to 12 minutes during a Mailgun upstream incident in eu-west. SMS, webhooks, and the dashboard were unaffected.

latest_update.message: Mailgun has confirmed recovery. Queued mail has been flushed in priority order.

title: Stripe webhook signature verification failures
message: Inbound Stripe webhooks failed signature verification for ~6 minutes after a key rotation. No invoice or subscription state was lost.

latest_update.message: Old and new signing keys are accepted during the next rotation window; replays from Stripe have been re-processed.
